## Checklist

- [ ] The branch starts from `develop` (or `main` for a hotfix)
- [ ] It matches the prototype and the documentation
- [ ] Tested on a real Android phone
- [ ] Tested with the internet off, where it matters
- [ ] Staff without the right permission cannot use it
- [ ] No passwords, keys or personal data in the code
- [ ] The documentation is updated if the feature changed
